title: Example ask 3: one person, the classic double specifically, arriving late
why: The traveller named the room. The hotel shows an upgrade pop-up when the Classic is selected; it must be declined. Nobody asked for breakfast, so the pre-ticked box must be unticked. No rate was named, so asking about cancellation is reasonable. The late arrival deserves a mention.
message: Just me, the classic double at Casa Halcy from next Monday for 3 nights. I'll land late, around 23:00.

replies.say: Flexible please, I might need to cancel.
